cues.text: Fund assets across chains, one set of controls. Kestrel Asset Management (fictional) holds fund assets on several chains. Its portfolio system connects through the API; the investment committee approves large moves; an AI treasury agent pays routine fund expenses.
cues.title: Asset manager · recorded on the running platform

cues.text: Per-fund keys on every chain, governed the same way. One platform for Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana and Cosmos keys. Multi-custodian orchestration and tokenisation are built (tested in CI) and not shown here.
cues.title: How it fits

cues.text: Connecting the portfolio system. The portfolio system creates a key per fund on each chain it needs. Each is a 2-of-3 key from its own ceremony: secp256k1 for Ethereum and Bitcoin, Ed25519 for Solana.
cues.title: Chapter 1

cues.text: Keys for Fund I on three chains. The same call for each chain. The platform runs the right ceremony for each signature scheme.
cues.title: Your application

cues.text: Three key ceremonies run at once across the same three parties: two ECDSA, one EdDSA.
cues.title: Three ceremonies

cues.text: Each fund now has deposit addresses on three chains. Bitcoin and Solana spends are proven separately on public test networks.
cues.title: Addresses

cues.text: A 30 ETH rebalancing move: over the threshold, so the portfolio manager and risk must both approve.
cues.title: Held for the committee

cues.text: The investment committee approves. Alice is the portfolio manager and Bob is risk. Both must approve with a fresh one-time code; neither asked for the move.
cues.title: Chapter 2

cues.text: The portfolio manager reviews the move.
cues.title: Sign in

cues.text: A one-time code from the person’s authenticator app. Every sign-in and every approval needs a fresh one.
cues.title: Second factor

cues.text: Amount, destination, the reason it was held and the Travel Rule details for the prime broker.
cues.title: The request

cues.text: Portfolio manager: approved.
cues.title: Approval

cues.text: Risk reviews the same request.
cues.title: Sign in

cues.text: A one-time code from the person’s authenticator app. Every sign-in and every approval needs a fresh one.
cues.title: Second factor

cues.text: Risk: approved. The quorum is met.
cues.title: Approval

cues.text: The rebalancing move ran once: two of three parties signed and the chain accepted it.
cues.title: Result

cues.text: Fund I on Ethereum, Bitcoin and Solana, beside the treasury key, all under the same policy.
cues.title: Keys

cues.text: Reconciliation. The fund administrator needs the books to match the chain. The platform checks every signed transfer against the chain and keeps the result as evidence.
cues.title: Chapter 3

cues.text: The operations administrator runs a reconciliation.
cues.title: Sign in

cues.text: A one-time code from the person’s authenticator app. Every sign-in and every approval needs a fresh one.
cues.title: Second factor

cues.text: The platform’s own ledger is compared with the chain. A transfer the chain does not show, or one the ledger does not know, is flagged.
cues.title: Reconciliation

cues.text: Each signed transfer was looked up on the chain by its hash. The result is stored, with who ran it and when, as evidence.
cues.title: Reconciliation

cues.text: An AI treasury agent. Routine fund expenses (audit, administration, data fees) are paid by an AI agent, only to the fund’s two approved service providers, within a monthly budget.
cues.title: Chapter 4

cues.text: An agent is a credential that can only pay, within limits a person sets. It is issued here, by an admin.
cues.title: Agents

cues.text: The fund administrator and the auditor only; R10,000 a payment, R30,000 a day, thirty days.
cues.title: Its terms

cues.text: The agent key is displayed this one time and stored only as a hash. It goes into the AI client’s secret configuration, never into a prompt. (Masked here.)
cues.title: Shown once

cues.text: Connecting an AI client. The MCP server is a small process the AI client starts. It holds only the agent key (and, for Travel Rule payments, the organisation’s own details) and calls the same gateway.
cues.title: Your application

cues.text: MCP is how AI assistants discover and call tools. The server exposes five; only one can move money, and only within the agent’s terms.
cues.title: Model Context Protocol

cues.text: Pay the fund administrator’s October fee, R8,200 (invoice FA-1010), and the auditor’s interim fee, R4,800 (AU-559).
cues.speaker: user

cues.text: → get_spending_status()

→ send_payment({"token":"tZAR","recipient":"0x4d48134E996AebE95E681a027DaEfEAF6e5C4492","amount":"8200","chain_id":1337,"purpose":"Fund administration fee, October, FA-1010","idempotency_key":"fa-1010-oct"})

The platform needs the recipient identified first: R8,200 is above the Travel Rule threshold. Invoice FA-1010 names the payee: Apex Fund Services (Pty) Ltd, which holds its own wallet. Retrying with the same idempotency key.
cues.speaker: agent

cues.text: → send_payment({"token":"tZAR","recipient":"0x4d48134E996AebE95E681a027DaEfEAF6e5C4492","amount":"8200","chain_id":1337,"purpose":"Fund administration fee, October, FA-1010","idempotency_key":"fa-1010-oct","beneficiary":{"name":"Apex Fund Services (Pty) Ltd"}})
→ send_payment({"token":"tZAR","recipient":"0xf5F258aB3c56052C7f1A6EAD23A0d9F98D68e3F8","amount":"4800","chain_id":1337,"purpose":"Interim audit fee, AU-559","idempotency_key":"au-559-interim"})
→ list_payments({"limit":5})
Both paid: R8,200 to the administrator, with a Travel Rule record, and R4,800 to the auditor, below the threshold. Each has its invoice reference on the record. R17,000 of today’s R30,000 remains.
cues.speaker: agent

cues.text: Retry the administrator’s fee in case it failed.
cues.speaker: user

cues.text: → send_payment({"token":"tZAR","recipient":"0x4d48134E996AebE95E681a027DaEfEAF6e5C4492","amount":"8200","chain_id":1337,"purpose":"Fund administration fee, October, FA-1010","idempotency_key":"fa-1010-oct","beneficiary":{"name":"Apex Fund Services (Pty) Ltd"}})
It had not failed: the platform recognised the same payment and did not pay it twice.
